description:
Teams (of humans and agents) share knowledge so that lessons learned by one are available to all. Agents are smart but they don't know your internal practices, IP, and legacy code. Shared memory fills-in those gaps, and is orders of magnitude more effective than RAG.

Each team's workspace is private and protected by role-based access controls. 

Create your account for free at https://memco.ai.

Available as an MCP, cross-compatible  with agents from all vendors.

Your memory space is private to your team, protected by enterprise-grade information security, and governed by policies.

defaultPrompt: Use my team's shared memory server to look for findings others have shared, and to share useful knowledge with others.
